question:
What is the empirically fitted relationship between the rate of change of money, wage, and rate of unemployment known as ?

[SSC CGL 2024]
options: Friedman’s model
Keynesian model
Baumol hypothesis
Phillips curve
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Phillips curve

Explanation:
The Phillips curve is a key economic concept that illustrates an inverse relationship between inflation and unemployment. It was first introduced by economist A.W. Phillips in 1958. According to this model, when unemployment is low, inflation tends to rise, and vice versa. This relationship is also observed between the rate of change in wages and the unemployment rate. The Phillips curve is crucial in macroeconomics for policy-making, especially in understanding the effects of monetary and fiscal policies.

Extra Facts:
The Phillips curve faced challenges during the stagflation of the 1970s (high inflation and high unemployment). Milton Friedman and Edmund Phelps questioned its validity and introduced the concept of the long-run Phillips curve, incorporating the idea of the Natural Rate of Unemployment (NAIRU). This shows that in the long run, the Phillips curve becomes vertical, implying no permanent trade-off between inflation and unemployment.

☛ What does the Phillips curve depict? → Inflation and unemployment
☛ What is stagflation? → High inflation and high unemployment
☛ What is the full form of NAIRU? → Non-Accelerating Inflation Rate of Unemployment
☛ Who proposed the Phillips curve? → A.W. Phillips
☛ How is the long-run Phillips curve shaped? → Vertical
question_hi:
धन, मजदूरी में परिवर्तन की दर और बेरोजगारी की दर के बीच अनुभवजन्य रूप से स्थापित संबंध को किस रूप में जाना जाता है?

[SSC CGL 2024]
options_hi: फ्रीडमैन मॉडल
केनेसियन मॉडल
बॉमोल परिकल्पना
फिलिप्स वक्र
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है फिलिप्स वक्र

Explanation:
फिलिप्स वक्र एक महत्वपूर्ण आर्थिक अवधारणा है जो मुद्रास्फीति और बेरोजगारी के बीच व्युत्क्रम संबंध को दर्शाती है। यह सबसे पहले 1958 में अर्थशास्त्री ए.डब्ल्यू. फिलिप्स द्वारा प्रस्तुत किया गया था। इसके अनुसार, जब बेरोजगारी की दर कम होती है, तो मुद्रास्फीति की दर बढ़ती है और इसके विपरीत। यह संबंध मजदूरी में परिवर्तन और बेरोजगारी दर के बीच भी देखा जाता है। यह मॉडल मैक्रोइकॉनॉमिक्स में नीति निर्माण के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है, विशेष रूप से मौद्रिक और राजकोषीय नीतियों के प्रभाव को समझने में।

Extra Facts:
फिलिप्स वक्र की अवधारणा को बाद में स्टैगफ्लेशन (1970 के दशक में उच्च मुद्रास्फीति और उच्च बेरोजगारी) के कारण चुनौती मिली। मिल्टन फ्रीडमैन और एडमंड फेल्प्स ने इस पर सवाल उठाया और दीर्घकालिक फिलिप्स वक्र की अवधारणा दी, जिसमें बेरोजगारी की प्राकृतिक दर (NAIRU) का विचार शामिल है। यह दिखाता है कि दीर्घकाल में फिलिप्स वक्र ऊर्ध्वाधर हो जाता है, जिसका अर्थ है कि मुद्रास्फीति और बेरोजगारी के बीच कोई स्थायी ट्रेड-ऑफ नहीं है।

question:
Which organization is associated with the estimation of the poverty line in India?

[SSC MTS 2022]
options: NITI Aayog
Reserve Bank of India
Indian Council of Agricultural Research
National Sample Survey Organisation
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is NITI Aayog

Explanation:
NITI Aayog is the primary organization associated with the estimation of the poverty line in India. It functions as the policy-making body of the Government of India and is responsible for compiling and analyzing poverty data. NITI Aayog has determined the poverty line based on recommendations from committees like the 'Tendulkar Committee' and 'Rangarajan Committee'. The organization assesses poverty by considering various aspects such as income, consumption, and socio-economic status.

Extra Facts:
To estimate the poverty line, NITI Aayog uses parameters like 'calorie consumption' and 'expenditure on basic needs'. In India, different standards are adopted for different states to define the poverty line because the cost of living varies across states. The purpose of poverty line estimation is to target government schemes and welfare programs effectively.

☛ Who estimates the poverty line in India? → NITI Aayog
☛ What is the Tendulkar Committee related to? → Poverty estimation
☛ Which organization releases poverty statistics in India? → NITI Aayog
☛ What is calorie consumption related to? → Poverty measurement
☛ What was the objective of the Rangarajan Committee? → Re-evaluating the poverty line

Explanation:
नीति आयोग (NITI Aayog) भारत में गरीबी रेखा के आकलन से संबंधित प्रमुख संस्था है। यह संस्था भारत सरकार की नीति निर्माण इकाई के रूप में कार्य करती है और गरीबी के आंकड़ों को संकलित करने तथा विश्लेषण करने का कार्य करती है। नीति आयोग ने 'टेंडुलकर समिति' और 'रंगराजन समिति' जैसी समितियों की सिफारिशों के आधार पर गरीबी रेखा का निर्धारण किया है। यह संस्था गरीबी के विभिन्न पहलुओं जैसे आय, खपत और सामाजिक-आर्थिक स्थिति को ध्यान में रखकर गरीबी का आकलन करती है।

question:
Workers who own and operate an enterprise to earn their livelihood are known as
_________.

[SSC GD 2022]
options: casual labourers
regular salried workers
self-employed
skill workers
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is self-employed

Explanation:
Self-employed workers are those who own and operate their own enterprise to earn their livelihood. They do not work for an employer but manage their own business. This concept is crucial in understanding labor market structures, where 'self-employed' workers are distinguished from 'salaried employees.' Examples include shopkeepers, freelancers (e.g., doctors, lawyers), and small business owners. Self-employment reflects entrepreneurship and contributes to economic diversity.

Extra Facts:
The proportion of self-employed workers indicates the size of the informal sector in an economy. Developing countries like India have a higher percentage of self-employed workers due to limited formal employment opportunities. Governments design policies (e.g., loans, social security) to support this group, as they foster economic resilience and innovation. The gig economy and digital platforms have further expanded self-employment opportunities globally.

☛ Who operates their own business? → Self-employed workers
☛ PM SVANidhi scheme targets: → Self-employed street vendors
☛ Key feature of the gig economy: → Self-employment
☛ MUDRA loans are designed for: → Self-employed entrepreneurs
question_hi:
वे श्रमिक जो अपनी आजीविका कमाने के लिए एक उद्यम के मालिक हैं और उसका संचालन करते हैं, उन्हें ______________ के रूप में जाना जाता है।

[SSC GD 2022]
options_hi: आकस्मिक श्रमिक
नियमित वेतनभोगी श्रमिक
स्वनियोजित (self-employed)
कुशल श्रमिक (skill workers)
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है स्वनियोजित (self-employed)

Explanation:
स्वनियोजित श्रमिक वे होते हैं जो अपनी आजीविका कमाने के लिए स्वयं का उद्यम चलाते हैं और उसके मालिक होते हैं। ये श्रमिक किसी अन्य व्यक्ति या संगठन के लिए काम नहीं करते बल्कि अपने स्वयं के व्यवसाय का संचालन करते हैं। यह अवधारणा श्रम बाजार के विभिन्न रूपों को समझने में महत्वपूर्ण है, जहां 'स्वनियोजित' श्रमिकों को 'वेतनभोगी श्रमिकों' से अलग किया जाता है। स्वनियोजित श्रमिकों के उदाहरणों में दुकानदार, स्वतंत्र पेशेवर (जैसे डॉक्टर, वकील), और छोटे व्यवसाय के मालिक शामिल हैं।

Extra Facts:
स्वनियोजित श्रमिकों की संख्या किसी देश की अर्थव्यवस्था में 'अनौपचारिक क्षेत्र' के आकार को दर्शाती है। भारत जैसे विकासशील देशों में स्वनियोजित श्रमिकों का प्रतिशत अधिक होता है क्योंकि यहां रोजगार के औपचारिक अवसर सीमित हैं। स्वनियोजित श्रमिकों को सरकारी योजनाओं, बैंक ऋण, और सामाजिक सुरक्षा लाभों तक पहुंच बढ़ाने के लिए विभिन्न नीतियां बनाई जाती हैं। यह समूह अर्थव्यवस्था में लचीलापन और उद्यमशीलता को बढ़ावा देता है।

question:
Who said the following?
“No society can surely be flourishing and happy, of which the far greater part of the members are poor and miserable.”

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Jagdish Bhagwati
Adam Smith
Amartya Sen
Jean Dreze
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Adam Smith

Explanation:
This statement was made by Adam Smith in his famous book 'The Wealth of Nations' (1776). Through this statement, Smith tried to explain that the prosperity and happiness of any society are possible only when the economic condition of the majority of its members is good. He believed that economic inequality hinders the overall development of society. Smith is also called the 'Father of Economics', and his ideas laid the foundation of modern economics.

Extra Facts:
Adam Smith also introduced the concept of the 'Invisible Hand', which suggests that even individual self-interest in the market can lead to social welfare. He argued in favor of a free-market economy and believed that government intervention should be minimal. Smith's ideas gave birth to classical economics, and his principles remain significant in the study of economics today.

question_hi:

कोई भी समाज निश्चित रूप से समृद्ध और सुखी नहीं हो सकता है, जिसके अधिकांश सदस्य गरीब और दुखी हों।

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options_hi: जगदीश भगवती
एडम स्मिथ
अमर्त्य सेन
जीन द्रेज
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है एडम स्मिथ

Explanation:
यह कथन एडम स्मिथ ने अपनी प्रसिद्ध पुस्तक 'द वेल्थ ऑफ नेशंस' (1776) में कहा था। स्मिथ ने इस कथन के माध्यम से यह समझाने का प्रयास किया कि किसी भी समाज की समृद्धि और खुशहाली तभी संभव है जब उसके अधिकांश सदस्यों की आर्थिक स्थिति अच्छी हो। उनका मानना था कि आर्थिक असमानता समाज के समग्र विकास में बाधक होती है। स्मिथ को 'अर्थशास्त्र का पिता' भी कहा जाता है और उनके विचारों ने आधुनिक अर्थशास्त्र की नींव रखी।

Extra Facts:
एडम स्मिथ ने 'अदृश्य हाथ' (Invisible Hand) की अवधारणा भी प्रस्तुत की, जो बताती है कि बाजार में व्यक्तिगत स्वार्थ के कारण भी सामाजिक कल्याण बढ़ सकता है। उन्होंने मुक्त बाजार अर्थव्यवस्था के पक्ष में तर्क दिए और माना कि सरकार का हस्तक्षेप न्यूनतम होना चाहिए। स्मिथ के विचारों ने शास्त्रीय अर्थशास्त्र को जन्म दिया और आज भी उनके सिद्धांत अर्थशास्त्र की पढ़ाई में महत्वपूर्ण हैं।

question:
Industrial development is a precondition for __________ of unemployment.

[SSC GD 2022]
options: addition
eradication
encouragement
acceleration
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is eradication

Explanation:
Industrial development is a precondition for the eradication of unemployment. Industrial development creates new employment opportunities, which reduces the unemployment rate. It boosts production and income in the economy, thereby increasing people's purchasing power. Additionally, industrial development improves economic growth and social welfare. Therefore, industrial development is a crucial factor in eliminating unemployment.

Extra Facts:
Types of unemployment include structural unemployment, cyclical unemployment, and seasonal unemployment. Industrial development particularly helps in reducing structural unemployment. Moreover, government policies like Make in India and Skill India also play a significant role in reducing unemployment.

☛ What is structural unemployment? → Unemployment caused by structural changes in the economy
☛ What is an example of seasonal unemployment? → Lack of employment in agriculture based on seasons
☛ When does cyclical unemployment occur? → During economic recessions
☛ Which scheme is running for employment generation? → MUDRA Scheme
question_hi:
बेरोजगारी के __________ लिए औद्योगिक विकास एक पूर्व शर्त है।

[SSC GD 2022]
options_hi: योग
उन्मूलन
प्रोत्साहन
त्वरण
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है उन्मूलन

Explanation:
औद्योगिक विकास बेरोजगारी के उन्मूलन के लिए एक पूर्व शर्त है। औद्योगिक विकास से रोजगार के नए अवसर पैदा होते हैं, जिससे बेरोजगारी की दर कम होती है। यह अर्थव्यवस्था में उत्पादन और आय को बढ़ाता है, जिससे लोगों की क्रय शक्ति में वृद्धि होती है। इसके अलावा, औद्योगिक विकास से आर्थिक विकास और सामाजिक कल्याण में भी सुधार होता है। इसलिए, बेरोजगारी को समाप्त करने के लिए औद्योगिक विकास एक महत्वपूर्ण कारक है।

Extra Facts:
बेरोजगारी के प्रकारों में ढांचागत बेरोजगारी, चक्रीय बेरोजगारी, और मौसमी बेरोजगारी शामिल हैं। औद्योगिक विकास से विशेष रूप से ढांचागत बेरोजगारी को दूर करने में मदद मिलती है। इसके अलावा, सरकारी नीतियाँ जैसे कि मेक इन इंडिया और स्किल इंडिया भी बेरोजगारी को कम करने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाती हैं।

question:
All of the following reasons can be attributed to the lack of access to credit for the poor EXCEPT:

[SSC CHSL 2023]
options: low information monitoring costs
lack of stable source of income
lenders prefer dealing in large loans in small numbers to minimise administration costs
absence of collateral with clear title
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is low information monitoring costs

Explanation:
The main reasons for the lack of access to credit for the poor include 'lack of stable source of income', 'lenders preferring to deal with large loans in small numbers to minimize administration costs', and 'absence of collateral with clear title'. These factors increase the risk for lenders, making them hesitant to provide loans to the poor. 'Low information monitoring costs' is an exception because it facilitates the lending process rather than hindering it. It is beneficial for lenders as it makes it easier to monitor borrowers' financial status.

Extra Facts:
In credit markets, 'information asymmetry' is a major issue where borrowers have more information than lenders. Problems like 'moral hazard' and 'adverse selection' also affect credit flow. The poor often lack 'collateral', which increases lenders' risk. Microfinance institutions use techniques like 'group lending' and 'graduated loans' to mitigate these issues.

☛ What is information asymmetry in credit markets? → Borrowers having more information
☛ What is moral hazard? → Risky behavior after obtaining a loan
☛ What is adverse selection? → Selection of bad borrowers
☛ What is collateral? → Asset pledged for loan security

solution_hi:

Explanation:

question:
The proportion of the population below the poverty line is called the poverty ratio or __________.

[SSC GD 2024]
options: Income Disparity Index
headcount ratio
Socioeconomic Quotient
Gini Coefficient
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is headcount ratio

Explanation:
The proportion of the population below the poverty line is called the 'headcount ratio'. It is a key economic indicator used to measure poverty levels in a country or region. This ratio shows the percentage of the total population living below the defined poverty line, based on income or consumption expenditure. Governments use this metric to assess the effectiveness of poverty alleviation programs and allocate resources accordingly.

Extra Facts:
The poverty line represents the minimum income level required to meet basic needs. In India, it is determined by the NITI Aayog (formerly Planning Commission). Other poverty measures include the Gini Coefficient (for income inequality) and the Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI), which considers health, education, and living standards. The headcount ratio is criticized for ignoring the depth of poverty but remains widely used due to its simplicity.

☛ How is the poverty line calculated? → Based on consumption expenditure & calorie intake

question:
Which of the following statements is NOT correct with respect to the poverty line ?
I. In India, it is normally estimated after every ten years.
II. The proportion of people below poverty line is not same for all social groups and economic categories in India.

[SSC CHSL 2022]
options: Both I and II
Only II
Neither I nor II
Only I
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Only I

Explanation:
The statement I is incorrect because in India, the poverty line is estimated by the National Sample Survey Organisation (NSSO) every five years, not every ten years. This estimation is based on the Consumer Expenditure Survey (CES). On the other hand, statement II is correct because the proportion of people below the poverty line varies across different social groups (e.g., SC, ST, OBC) and economic categories (e.g., urban and rural) in India. This disparity reflects socio-economic inequalities.

Extra Facts:
In India, the Tendulkar Committee (2009) and Rangarajan Committee (2014) recommendations are used to calculate the poverty line. This line is based on calorie consumption and income level. Rural areas require 2400 calories per day, while urban areas require 2100 calories per day. The poverty line is used for government schemes and targeted subsidies.

[SSC CHSL 2022]

केवल ।

Explanation:

Extra Facts:

question:
What is the term used for people who regularly move in and out of the poverty line?

[SSC GD 2022]
options: Chronic poor
Churning poor
Usually Poor
Occasionally poor
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Churning poor

Explanation:
The term Churning Poor refers to people who frequently move above and below the poverty line due to economic instability, seasonal employment, or fluctuating income. This group is trapped in the 'cycle of poverty' and their status changes with economic booms or recessions. This concept highlights the dynamic nature of poverty, where individuals are not permanently poor but experience poverty intermittently. It contrasts with Chronic Poor, who remain in poverty persistently.

Extra Facts:
Poverty types also include Chronic Poor (consistently below the poverty line) and Non-Poor (never below the line). In India, poverty is measured based on reports by the Tendulkar Committee and Rangarajan Committee, focusing on income and consumption expenditure. Programs like MGNREGA aim to reduce transient poverty by providing employment.

चक्रीय निर्धनता (Churning Poor) उन लोगों को संदर्भित करती है जो निर्धनता रेखा के ऊपर और नीचे नियमित रूप से आते-जाते रहते हैं। यह आर्थिक अस्थिरता, मौसमी रोजगार, या अस्थायी आय में उतार-चढ़ाव के कारण होता है। यह समूह 'गरीबी के चक्र' में फंसा होता है और आर्थिक सुधार या मंदी के साथ ही इसकी स्थिति बदलती रहती है। यह अवधारणा गरीबी के गतिशील स्वरूप को दर्शाती है, जहां लोग स्थायी रूप से गरीब नहीं होते, बल्कि समय-समय पर गरीबी का सामना करते हैं।

Extra Facts:
गरीबी के प्रकारों में चिरकालिक निर्धनता (Chronic Poor) भी शामिल है, जो लगातार गरीबी में जीवन यापन करते हैं। वहीं गैर-गरीब (Non-Poor) वे होते हैं जो कभी गरीबी रेखा से नीचे नहीं आते। भारत में गरीबी का आकलन तेंदुलकर समिति और रंगराजन समिति की रिपोर्ट्स के आधार पर किया जाता है, जो आय और उपभोग व्यय के मापदंडों पर निर्भर करता है।

question:
Which of the following organisations conducts the sample surveys for calculating poverty line in India ?

[SSC GD 2022]
options: RBI
CSO
Ministry of Finance
NSSO
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is NSSO

Explanation:
The National Sample Survey Office (NSSO) conducts sample surveys for calculating the poverty line in India. It operates under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI). The 'Consumer Expenditure Survey (CES)' conducted by NSSO is the primary basis for poverty line estimation. This survey collects detailed data on household income, consumption expenditure, and other socio-economic aspects. Committees like the 'Tendulkar Committee' and 'Rangarajan Committee' have used NSSO data to re-evaluate India's poverty line.

Extra Facts:
Parameters like calorie intake, consumption expenditure, and Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) are used for poverty line calculation. NSSO surveys define separate poverty lines for rural and urban areas. The World Bank uses an international poverty line of $1.90/day (2011 PPP). In India, PM-Kisan welfare schemes are targeted based on NSSO data.

solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 183

Explanation:
According to the Census of India, a 'Marginal Worker' is defined as a person who works for less than 183 days (or six months) in a year. This classification helps differentiate between main workers (183+ days) and marginal workers in labor market analysis. Marginal workers are typically engaged in agriculture, unorganized sectors, or casual labor. This data is crucial for evaluating employment trends and framing welfare policies.

Extra Facts:
The main worker category includes those employed for 183 days or more annually. India's labor market has a significant proportion of marginal workers, highlighting issues like income instability and underemployment. The Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) by NSSO also uses this classification to assess employment-unemployment dynamics.

question:
______ unemployment occurs with changes in economic activity over the business cycle

[SSC CGL 2022]
options: Frictional
Cyclical
Structural
Technological
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Cyclical

Explanation:
Cyclical unemployment occurs due to fluctuations in economic activity over the business cycle. During a recession, demand for goods and services declines, leading to reduced production and layoffs. Conversely, during an economic boom, employment opportunities rise as demand increases. This type of unemployment is temporary and directly linked to macroeconomic performance. Keynesian economics emphasizes government intervention (e.g., fiscal policies) to mitigate cyclical unemployment by stimulating demand.

Extra Facts:
Other major unemployment types include frictional (temporary unemployment during job transitions), structural (caused by industrial/technological shifts), and technological (automation-driven). Cyclical unemployment is a key focus in countercyclical policies, where governments increase spending or cut taxes during downturns. India’s Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) by NSSO tracks unemployment trends, including cyclical patterns.

बेरोजगारी के अन्य प्रमुख प्रकारों में आंशिक बेरोजगारी (जब व्यक्ति पूर्ण समय कार्य नहीं कर पाता), संरचनात्मक बेरोजगारी (तकनीकी परिवर्तन या उद्योगों के पतन के कारण), और तकनीकी बेरोजगारी (मशीनीकरण या स्वचालन के कारण) शामिल हैं। चक्रीय बेरोजगारी को केनेसियन अर्थशास्त्र में विशेष महत्व दिया गया है, क्योंकि यह सरकारी हस्तक्षेप और राजकोषीय नीतियों द्वारा नियंत्रित की जा सकती है।

question:
Formula to find the unemployment rate is _________ .

[SSC MTS 2022]
options: (Unemployed male workers/Total labour force) × 1000
(Unemployed workers/Total labour force) × 100
(Employed workers/Total labour force) × 100
(Employed workers/Male labour force) × 100
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is (Unemployed workers/Total labour force) × 100

Explanation:
The correct formula to calculate the unemployment rate is (Unemployed workers/Total labour force) × 100. This is the standard method in economics to measure unemployment. 'Unemployed workers' refers to those who are willing and able to work but cannot find employment, while 'Total labour force' includes both employed and unemployed workers. The percentage obtained from this formula indicates the state of unemployment in an economy, serving as a crucial economic indicator for governments and policymakers.

Extra Facts:
Unemployment rate is a key economic indicator that helps measure a country's economic health. High unemployment often signals economic recession, while low rates indicate a strong economy. There are different types of unemployment such as frictional, structural, cyclical, and seasonal. In India, the unemployment rate is measured through the Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS).

question:
Which of the following is the compelling factor that produced a very high repayment rate of 98% in the concept of lending to groups of poor women, initiated by Dr Yunus ?

[SSC CHSL 2023]
options: Involvement of 'loan sharks'
Removal of the defaulter from the group
Joint liability putting social pressure to repay loans
Use of the services of aggressive loan recovery agents
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Joint liability putting social pressure to repay loans

Explanation:
The 'Microcredit' scheme initiated by Dr. Yunus involves lending to groups of poor women. Its success is primarily due to 'Joint Liability', where all group members are collectively responsible for each other's loans. This creates social pressure, leading to a repayment rate of 98%. The concept relies on 'Social Capital', where group reputation and relationships motivate repayment, reducing issues like 'Moral Hazard' and 'Adverse Selection'. This model aligns with 'Peer Monitoring' and fosters trust within communities.

Extra Facts:
Grameen Bank, founded by Dr. Yunus in 1983, popularized Microfinance. Its model involves 5-member groups, with loans initially given to 2 members and later to others—a process called 'Step Lending'. This ensures 'Peer Pressure' and minimizes loan misuse. The bank focuses on 'Poverty Alleviation' and 'Women Empowerment', offering collateral-free loans. It won the Nobel Peace Prize (2006) for its impact on socio-economic development.

Explanation:
डॉ. यूनुस द्वारा शुरू की गई 'माइक्रोक्रेडिट' योजना में गरीब महिलाओं के समूहों को ऋण दिया जाता है। इसकी सफलता का मुख्य कारण 'संयुक्त देयता' (Joint Liability) है, जिसमें समूह के सभी सदस्य एक-दूसरे के ऋण के लिए जिम्मेदार होते हैं। यह सामाजिक दबाव बनाता है, जिससे चुकौती दर 98% तक पहुँच जाती है। यह अवधारणा 'सामाजिक पूंजी' (Social Capital) पर आधारित है, जहाँ समूह की प्रतिष्ठा और सामाजिक संबंध ऋण चुकाने के लिए प्रेरित करते हैं। इससे 'नैतिक खतरा' (Moral Hazard) और 'प्रतिकूल चयन' (Adverse Selection) जैसी समस्याएँ कम होती हैं।

question:
How is the poverty line in India typically determined?

[SSC GD 2024]
options: Access to healthcare facilities
Religious affiliation
Levels of income and consumption
Quality of education
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Levels of income and consumption

Explanation:
In India, the poverty line is typically determined based on levels of income and consumption. This method was adopted by the Planning Commission (now NITI Aayog). The poverty line is calculated using calorie intake (2400 kcal per day in rural areas and 2100 kcal in urban areas) and minimum required income. The Tendulkar Committee (2009) refined this methodology by including both food and non-food expenditures. This plays a crucial role in framing policies for economic inequality and development.

Extra Facts:
The criteria for determining the poverty line have evolved over time. The Alagh Committee (1979) introduced calorie-based estimation. The Rangarajan Committee (2014) added dimensions like education, health, and housing. Data for poverty estimation is collected by the National Sample Survey Organisation (NSSO). This is vital for policy-making and resource allocation.

☛ What is the daily calorie requirement in rural areas? → 2400 kcal
☛ What is the urban poverty line based on? → 2100 kcal

question:
Under which type of unemployment a person contributes less than their capability?

[SSC MTS 2022]
options: Frictional unemployment
Disguised unemployment
Compulsory unemployment
Cyclical unemployment
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Disguised unemployment

Explanation:
Disguised unemployment refers to a situation where more people are employed in a job than actually required. In this case, removing some workers does not affect the total output because they were not contributing to their full potential. This type of unemployment is common in agriculture and the informal sector, where surplus labor exists. It is called 'disguised' because workers appear to be employed, but their marginal productivity is zero.

Extra Facts:
Disguised unemployment is a major issue in developing countries, especially in rural areas, where all family members engage in farming, but removing a few does not reduce output. It reflects resource wastage and economic inefficiency. Solutions include creating more employment opportunities in industries and the service sector.

Explanation:
प्रच्छन्न बेरोज़गारी (Disguised Unemployment) वह स्थिति है जब किसी कार्य में लगे व्यक्तियों की संख्या उस कार्य के लिए आवश्यक संख्या से अधिक होती है। इस स्थिति में, कुछ श्रमिकों को हटा देने पर भी उत्पादन पर कोई प्रभाव नहीं पड़ता, क्योंकि वे अपनी पूर्ण क्षमता से काम नहीं कर रहे होते। यह आमतौर पर कृषि क्षेत्र और असंगठित क्षेत्र में देखा जाता है, जहाँ अधिशेष श्रमिक होते हैं। यह बेरोज़गारी का एक 'अदृश्य' रूप है, क्योंकि श्रमिक तकनीकी रूप से रोजगार में होते हैं, लेकिन वास्तव में उनका योगदान नगण्य होता है।

question:
The unemployment rate is calculated as the ratio of ____________ .

[SSC GD 2024]
options: Unemployed workers and labour force
Employed workers and labour force
Total population and labour force
Total population and unemployed workers
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Unemployed workers and labour force

Explanation:
The unemployment rate is calculated as the ratio of the number of unemployed workers to the labour force. The labour force includes all individuals who are willing and able to work, whether employed or unemployed. This rate is a key indicator of employment conditions in an economy. A high unemployment rate often signals economic recession or structural issues, while a low rate indicates a healthy economy.

Extra Facts:
There are different types of unemployment, such as frictional unemployment (during job transitions), structural unemployment (skills-job mismatch), and cyclical unemployment (due to economic downturns). The labour force comprises individuals aged 16 or older who are capable and willing to work. Students, retirees, and homemakers are excluded from the labour force in unemployment calculations.

question:
Economists call unemployment prevailing in Indian farms as ______unemployment.

[SSC GD 2024]

closed
disguised
frictional
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is disguised

Explanation:
The unemployment prevailing in Indian farms is called 'disguised unemployment'. It refers to a situation where more workers are employed than actually needed, making their marginal productivity zero or negligible. Even if some workers are removed, the total output remains unaffected. This is common in agriculture where family members work on farms despite not being required, indicating inefficient resource utilization. It's a key feature of labor surplus economies.

Extra Facts:
Disguised unemployment is prevalent in developing nations, especially in rural sectors with limited job opportunities. Unlike open unemployment (visible joblessness) or frictional unemployment (temporary unemployment during job transitions), disguised unemployment masks underemployment. The term 'closed unemployment' doesn’t exist in economics. Structural unemployment arises due to technological changes, while cyclical unemployment results from economic downturns.

question:
Which of the following unemployment is the result of depression in an economy?

[SSC MTS 2022]
options: Cyclical unemployment
Frictional unemployment
Seasonal unemployment
Structural unemployment
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Cyclical unemployment

Explanation:
Cyclical unemployment occurs due to economic downturns or recessions. It results from a decline in aggregate demand, forcing firms to reduce production and lay off workers. This type of unemployment is directly linked to the business cycle (boom-recession). During economic growth, cyclical unemployment decreases, but it rises during depressions. Other types like frictional (job transitions), seasonal (weather-dependent industries), and structural (technological shifts) are not directly caused by economic depression.

Extra Facts:
Major Types of Unemployment:
1. Cyclical: Tied to economic fluctuations.
2. Frictional: Time spent searching for a new job.
3. Structural: Caused by industry/technology changes.
4. Seasonal: Agriculture/tourism-related.
The Natural Rate of Unemployment includes frictional and structural unemployment but excludes cyclical unemployment.

☛ Which unemployment is also called 'search unemployment'? → Frictional unemployment
☛ Which unemployment arises from technological changes? → Structural unemployment
☛ Which type of unemployment is short-term? → Frictional unemployment
☛ Which unemployment increases during a recession? → Cyclical unemployment

question:
Which of the following type of unemployment is there in rural areas?
I. Seasonal Unemployment
II. Disguised Unemployment

[SSC GD 2022]
options: Neither I nor II
Only I
Both I and II
Only II
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Both I and II

Explanation:
Rural areas experience both Seasonal Unemployment and Disguised Unemployment. Seasonal Unemployment occurs when people are unemployed during certain months of the year due to the seasonal nature of agricultural work, which is common in rural economies. Disguised Unemployment happens when more workers are engaged in a job than required, making their marginal productivity zero or negligible. This is prevalent in rural areas of countries like India, where agriculture employs excess labor.

Extra Facts:
Seasonal Unemployment and Disguised Unemployment are major issues in rural economies of developing countries. Seasonal Unemployment can be mitigated by creating non-agricultural employment opportunities, while Disguised Unemployment can be addressed by shifting workers to more productive sectors through education and skill development. Both types of unemployment reflect inefficient utilization of economic resources.

☛ What is the main cause of rural unemployment in India? → Overdependence on agriculture
☛ What is an example of disguised unemployment? → More workers engaged in a farm than required
☛ In which sector is seasonal unemployment most prevalent? → Agricultural sector

question:
Who is the founder of modern micro finance ?

[SSC CHSL 2024]
options: Muhammad Yunus
Rangarajan
YV Reddy

solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Muhammad Yunus

Explanation:
Muhammad Yunus is regarded as the 'Father of Modern Microfinance'. He founded the Grameen Bank in 1976, which aimed to provide small loans (microcredit) to the poor, especially women, without any collateral. This model promotes financial inclusion and aids in poverty alleviation. For this contribution, Yunus was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in 2006. This approach to microfinance is an excellent example of social entrepreneurship and sustainable development.

Extra Facts:
- Microfinance includes services like small loans, savings accounts, insurance, and training.
- It connects the informal sector with the formal financial system.
- In India, Self-Help Groups (SHGs) and Microfinance Institutions (MFIs) operate on this concept.
- Institutions like RBI and NABARD regulate and promote microfinance.

question:
If unemployment continues for long-term in a country, it is called ________ unemployment.

[SSC CHSL 2022]
options: casual
technological
frictional
Chronic
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Chronic

Explanation:
Chronic Unemployment occurs when unemployment persists in a country for an extended period. It is often caused by structural issues or prolonged economic downturns, where job opportunities remain scarce, and the unemployment rate stays high for a long time. This differs from other types of unemployment such as casual (temporary), technological (due to automation), or frictional (job transition phase). Chronic unemployment requires long-term solutions like economic reforms, skill development programs, and employment generation schemes to address the underlying causes.

Extra Facts:
Major Types of Unemployment:
1. Cyclical Unemployment - Caused by economic recessions.
2. Structural Unemployment - Arises due to technological or industrial shifts.
3. Frictional Unemployment - Occurs during job transitions.
4. Seasonal Unemployment - Linked to seasonal industries like agriculture.
Chronic Unemployment has severe impacts on human capital and economic growth, requiring policy interventions.

1. चक्रीय बेरोजगारी - आर्थिक मंदी के दौरान होती है।
2. संरचनात्मक बेरोजगारी - अर्थव्यवस्था में तकनीकी या औद्योगिक परिवर्तनों के कारण होती है।
3. प्रतिरोधात्मक बेरोजगारी - नौकरी बदलने या नई नौकरी की तलाश के दौरान होती है।
4. मौसमी बेरोजगारी - कृषि या पर्यटन जैसे मौसमी उद्योगों में होती है।
दीर्घकालिक बेरोजगारी का सबसे बड़ा प्रभाव मानव पूँजी और अर्थव्यवस्था की वृद्धि पर पड़ता है।

question:
When a person seems to be working, but their work is not contributing to the output, it is known as______.

[SSC GD 2024]
options: Cyclical unemployment
Disguised unemployment
Frictional unemployment
Seasonal unemployment
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Disguised unemployment

Explanation:
Disguised unemployment occurs when more workers are engaged in a job than actually required, and removing some of them does not affect the total output. This is commonly seen in agriculture and the informal sector, where family members appear to be working but their contribution is negligible. It is an 'invisible' form of unemployment because it is not reflected in official statistics.

Extra Facts:
Disguised unemployment is a major issue in developing countries, especially in rural areas. It can be addressed by creating employment opportunities in industries and the service sector. This type of unemployment indicates 'zero marginal productivity of labour.' In India, schemes like MGNREGA help reduce this problem by providing guaranteed wage employment.

☛ Unemployment that occurs while switching jobs is called? → Frictional unemployment
☛ Which unemployment is caused by excess labour in agriculture? → Disguised unemployment
☛ Example of seasonal unemployment? → Agricultural labourers (during off-seasons)
☛ How is the unemployment rate calculated? → (Unemployed persons / Total labour force) × 100
question_hi:
जब कोई व्यक्ति काम करता हुआ प्रतीत होता है, लेकिन उसका काम उत्पादन (output) में योगदान नहीं दे रहा है, तो इसे __________ के रूप में जाना जाता है।

[SSC GD 2024]
options_hi: चक्रीय बेरोजगारी
प्रच्छन्न बेरोजगारी
घर्षण बेरोजगारी
मौसमी बेरोजगारी
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है प्रच्छन्न बेरोजगारी

Explanation:
प्रच्छन्न बेरोजगारी (Disguised Unemployment) तब होती है जब किसी कार्य में लगे श्रमिकों की संख्या आवश्यकता से अधिक होती है, और उनमें से कुछ को हटा देने पर भी उत्पादन (output) पर कोई प्रभाव नहीं पड़ता। यह आमतौर पर कृषि क्षेत्र और असंगठित क्षेत्र में देखा जाता है, जहाँ परिवार के सभी सदस्य काम करते हुए दिखाई देते हैं, लेकिन वास्तव में उनका योगदान नगण्य होता है। यह बेरोजगारी का एक 'अदृश्य' रूप है, क्योंकि यह आधिकारिक आँकड़ों में दर्ज नहीं होता।

Extra Facts:
प्रच्छन्न बेरोजगारी विकासशील देशों में एक प्रमुख समस्या है, विशेषकर ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में। इसका समाधान उद्योगों और सेवा क्षेत्र में रोजगार के अवसर बढ़ाकर किया जा सकता है। यह बेरोजगारी 'श्रम की सीमांत उत्पादकता शून्य' (Marginal Productivity of Labour = 0) की स्थिति को दर्शाती है। भारत में महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी अधिनियम (MGNREGA) जैसी योजनाएँ इस समस्या को कम करने में सहायक हैं।

question:
As per Planning Commission of India, in 2004–05, the percentage of total population of India below poverty line (Lakadawala Poverty Estimates combined) was:

[SSC MTS 2024]
options: 38.86%
27.5%
44.48%
35.97%
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 27.5%

Explanation:
According to the Planning Commission of India, in 2004–05, 27.5% of India's population was below the poverty line based on the 'Lakdawala Poverty Estimates'. This method, adopted in 1993, defined the poverty line based on calorie consumption (2400 kcal per person per day in rural areas and 2100 kcal in urban areas). It was later replaced by the 'Tendulkar Committee' methodology in 2011-12, which included both food and non-food expenditures.

Extra Facts:
The poverty line in India has evolved over time. After the Lakdawala Committee (1993), the Tendulkar Committee (2009) introduced a new approach, followed by the Rangarajan Committee (2014). In 2004-05, rural poverty was 28.3%, urban poverty was 25.7%, and the combined average was 27.5%.

☛ What is the calorie requirement in rural areas? → 2400 kcal

question_hi:
भारत के योजना आयोग के अनुसार, 2004-05 में गरीबी रेखा से नीचे भारत की कुल जनसंख्या (लकड़ावाला गरीबी अनुमानों को शामिल करते हुए) का प्रतिशत कितना था?

[SSC MTS 2024]
options_hi: 38.86%
27.5%
44.48%
35.97%
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है 27.5%

Explanation:
भारत के योजना आयोग के अनुसार, 2004-05 में गरीबी रेखा से नीचे जनसंख्या का प्रतिशत 27.5% था। यह आंकड़ा 'लकड़ावाला गरीबी अनुमान' पद्धति पर आधारित है, जिसे 1993 में अपनाया गया था। इस पद्धति में गरीबी रेखा का निर्धारण कैलोरी उपभोग (2400 कैलोरी प्रति व्यक्ति प्रतिदिन ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में और 2100 कैलोरी शहरी क्षेत्रों में) के आधार पर किया जाता था। यह पद्धति 2011-12 में 'तेंदुलकर समिति' की नई पद्धति द्वारा प्रतिस्थापित कर दी गई थी।

Extra Facts:
गरीबी रेखा का निर्धारण भारत में समय-समय पर बदलता रहा है। लकड़ावाला समिति (1993) के बाद तेंदुलकर समिति (2009) ने नई पद्धति प्रस्तुत की, जिसमें खाद्य और गैर-खाद्य दोनों खर्चों को शामिल किया गया। इसके बाद रंगराजन समिति (2014) ने और अधिक व्यापक मापदंड सुझाए। 2004-05 में गरीबी दर ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में 28.3% और शहरी क्षेत्रों में 25.7% थी, जिसका संयुक्त औसत 27.5% था।

question:
Which one is not the cause of Poverty?

[SSC GD 2024]
options: Low level of productivity
Slow growth of population
Underdeveloped nature of economy
State Policies
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Slow growth of population

Explanation:
The primary causes of poverty include low level of productivity, underdeveloped nature of the economy, and state policies. Low productivity limits income and employment opportunities, while an underdeveloped economy leads to unequal resource distribution and lack of infrastructure. State policies can also perpetuate poverty if they fail to reduce inequalities. However, slow population growth is generally not considered a cause of poverty, as rapid population growth is what strains resources.

Extra Facts:
The poverty line is the minimum income level required to meet basic needs. In India, the Tendulkar Committee (2009) defined separate poverty lines for urban and rural areas. The Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) measures poverty based on health, education, and living standards. Poverty alleviation programs like MGNREGA, PMAY, and NFSA help reduce poverty.

☛ What is the main cause of poverty in India? → Unemployment and inequality
☛ In which type of economy is poverty more prevalent? → Underdeveloped economy
question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा निर्धनता का कारण नहीं है?

[SSC GD 2024]
options_hi: उत्पादकता का निम्न स्तर
जनसंख्या की धीमी वृद्धि
अर्थव्यवस्था की अविकसित प्रकृति
राज्य की नीतियां
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है जनसंख्या की धीमी वृद्धि

Explanation:
निर्धनता के मुख्य कारणों में उत्पादकता का निम्न स्तर, अर्थव्यवस्था की अविकसित प्रकृति, और राज्य की नीतियां शामिल हैं। उत्पादकता का निम्न स्तर आय और रोजगार के अवसरों को सीमित करता है, जबकि अविकसित अर्थव्यवस्था संसाधनों के असमान वितरण और बुनियादी ढांचे की कमी का कारण बनती है। राज्य की नीतियां भी गरीबी को बढ़ावा दे सकती हैं यदि वे असमानताओं को कम करने में विफल रहती हैं। हालांकि, जनसंख्या की धीमी वृद्धि आमतौर पर गरीबी का कारण नहीं मानी जाती, क्योंकि तेज जनसंख्या वृद्धि ही संसाधनों पर दबाव बढ़ाती है।

Extra Facts:
गरीबी रेखा वह न्यूनतम आय स्तर है जो व्यक्ति को बुनियादी जरूरतों को पूरा करने के लिए आवश्यक है। भारत में, टेंडुलकर समिति (2009) ने शहरी और ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों के लिए अलग-अलग गरीबी रेखा निर्धारित की। बहुआयामी गरीबी सूचकांक (MPI) स्वास्थ्य, शिक्षा और जीवन स्तर जैसे कारकों पर आधारित है। निर्धनता उन्मूलन कार्यक्रम जैसे मनरेगा, PMAY, और NFSA गरीबी कम करने में मदद करते हैं।
